I don't know how or why this happened. Proxyman sent us the raw so I heard the call of nature. The rest is history. 
Yes, this is an actual doujin, animated on cel by fans in the 90s and distributed from person to person. Naturally, you won't find this in any database. Proxyman who is privy to all the details will probably explain it better in the comments. 
As far as I can tell, there exists no DDD capture of this, so the Lain32 version is the best we've got. 
Porn doujins are the only piece of eva I'm gonna work on, ever. There exists an [ancient English hardsub](https://sukebei.nyaa.si/view/3349686) for this, recorded on top of a Chinese hardsub, and the mere thought of that kind of arrangement makes me apoplectic, so we resubbed this with a better raw. 
While the previously accepted translation of "人類補姦計画" as "Human Rape Project" amused me greatly, I find the "Complementary Fornication Plan" variant that gpt gave me more accurate, while still being decently amusing, so I went with that.
